Untrusted sessions must not terminate execution via Debugger.resume({terminateOnResume:true})
Runtime.terminateExecution on untrusted session:
{
    error : {
        code : -32000
        message : Runtime.terminateExecution is not allowed for untrusted clients
    }
    id : <messageId>
}
Debugger.resume({terminateOnResume:true}):
{
    error : {
        code : -32000
        message : `terminateOnResume` is not allowed for untrusted clients
    }
    id : <messageId>
}
{
    id : <messageId>
    result : {
        result : {
            type : boolean
            value : true
        }
    }
}
